name: Your First Strumming Pattern Ever
instructions: A basic strumming pattern (down, down, up, up, down, up) is the backbone of most beginner songs.
Practice the pattern on a muted (unfretted) guitar first, focusing purely on the arm motion before adding chords.
Keep your strumming arm loose from the elbow, not stiff from the wrist -- tension is the most common beginner strumming mistake.
Watch today's video for your very first strumming pattern.
